scope: Numerical integration dispatch, stage inputs, error controls, fallback and output bookkeeping in one pinned implementation; no full material execution, source fixes or canonical Atlas model admission.

findings.claim: Only scheme 2 enters the implicit driver. Codes 7, 8 and 9 all select ForwardEuler inside MaxStrainInc. Unknown codes use ModifiedEuler.
findings.reference_consequence: Record numeric code and actual dispatch, not header comments or algorithm labels. Reject unknown codes in a future driver.

findings.claim: The max-component threshold is 1e-5. Above it, the wrapper uses floor(max_abs_component/threshold)+1 steps. Only stress, total strain, alpha and fabric are advanced between iterations; current elastic strain and reversal anchor remain fixed. Local nVoidRatio, nG, nK and nDGamma are not assigned back to their scalar output arguments in this branch.
findings.reference_consequence: Capture elastic strain, scalar outputs and tangents at each inner call; do not infer equivalence to repeated public committed steps.

findings.claim: A full trial call precedes a signed work-increment test against numeric 1e-4. If exceeded, exactly two kernel calls replace the tensors; the wrapper does not recursively recheck the work bound. Elastic strain and reversal anchor are not advanced between those calls; local scalar outputs are not copied back.
findings.reference_consequence: This is neither an absolute-energy guarantee nor a unit-invariant adaptive limit. Observe which trial scalar outputs survive the two-call replacement.

findings.claim: At path fraction T, these routines evaluate void ratio using NextStrain + T*(NextStrain-CurStrain). This is shifted by one full caller increment relative to interpolation from CurStrain.
findings.reference_consequence: Record stage strain and void ratio as well as committed final state. A commit-time recomputation cannot undo the stress/history response to stage density.

findings.claim: ModifiedEuler fixes error tolerance at 1e-4 and minimum path step at 1e-6; RK45 uses mTolR and minimum 1e-3. Stress error normalization switches at numeric stress norm 0.5. RK45 also checks alpha error, but neither estimator includes fabric. NewtonIter2 has 30 iterations and uses (initial residual norm+1)*mTolR; its residual combines dimensionless strain/history blocks with an unscaled stress-valued yield residual.
findings.reference_consequence: Changing a supplied tolerance need not refine every integrator. Record pressure units and independently assess fabric and residual scaling.

findings.claim: An error above tolerance at the minimum step can still advance stress and elastic strain, project stress ratio, and reconstruct alpha without advancing fabric in that branch. A negative-pressure candidate at the minimum step can return before T reaches 1. The ordinary ModifiedEuler acceptance calls stress correction; RK45 leaves that call commented out.
findings.reference_consequence: API success does not prove tolerance satisfaction, completion of the caller increment or complete history advancement. These branches need explicit runtime observations.

findings.claim: Low trial pressure disables the specialized negative-pressure Newton call and falls back to explicit integration. Other failed implicit solves may recurse on half increments (depth limit 10), or use explicit fallback, after which errFlag is set to success. The 50-step explicit-initial-guess branch exists but SchemeControl starts at 2.
findings.reference_consequence: A scheme-2 result does not prove a pure Backward Euler update. Record actual fallback path, recursion depth and effective residual/yield checks.

findings.claim: The recursive first-half result advances stress, total strain, alpha and fabric before the second half, but not cEStrain. The second-half plastic multiplier is copied as NextDGamma and then used to reconstruct elastic strain over the full caller increment.
findings.reference_consequence: Compare elastic/plastic strain and multiplier bookkeeping, not only final stress. Runtime consequences remain unverified.

findings.claim: integrate returns void and ignores the implicit routine return value; the 3D setTrialStrain wrapper returns zero after integration.
findings.reference_consequence: A zero public return value is not an independent convergence, admissibility or whole-increment-completion certificate.

reference_cases.purpose: Compare codes 7, 8 and 9 with controlled identical preparation and instrumented inner-call selection.
Probe max components just below, equal to and just above 1e-5, and exact multiples; retain engineering-shear versus Mandel mapping.
Compare internal step packets with an explicitly staged replay that preserves the same reversal anchor; observe elastic strain and scalar outputs.
Instrument density at accepted and rejected internal stages for nonzero volumetric increments; compare trial and committed void ratio.
Vary supplied TolR independently for ModifiedEuler and RK45, recording internal step counts and all history errors.
Replay identical physical paths in Pa and kPa, including the numeric norm threshold, yield tolerance and work limit; record each difference.
Force minimum-step excessive error and record stress, alpha, fabric, elastic strain and whether the requested increment was completed.
Force minimum-step negative-pressure rejection and compare public return code against actual completed path fraction.
Instrument direct Newton, recursive and explicit fallback paths for scheme 2; retain solver and physical-state diagnostics.
Inspect both recursive half-steps and compare full-parent elastic strain reconstruction and cumulative multiplier to the stored packet.
